title: Integrating market sentiments for stock price prediction: A comparative study of Bi-LSTM and multilayer perceptions
abstract: arXiv:2611.23057v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This study investigates the integration of sentiment analysis with machine learning models to forecast stock price movements using the Nvidia Corporation as a case study. Sentiment scores were derived from Nvidia-related financial news headlines using two sentiment analysis tools: FinBERT, a domain-specific tool, and TextBlob, a general-purpose tool. These scores were integrated into predictive frameworks based on bidirectional long short-term memory (Bi-LSTM) networks and multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) developed alongside historical stock price data. This study assesses the predictive performance over the entire observation period and across distinct market phases: bullish, stagnation, and strong bullish conditions. The findings indicate that sentiment features enhance predictive accuracy in specific contexts, particularly during stagnation phases, with TextBlob demonstrating superior performance to FinBERT in specific scenarios. translated_title: 整合市场情绪进行股价预测：Bi-LSTM与多层感知机的比较研究
translated_abstract: 本研究以英伟达公司为案例，探讨将情感分析与机器学习模型相结合以预测股价走势。研究使用两种情感分析工具从与英伟达相关的金融新闻标题中提取情感分数：一种是特定领域工具FinBERT，另一种是通用型工具TextBlob。这些情感分数被整合到基于双向长短期记忆网络（Bi-LSTM）和多层感知机（MLPs）的预测框架中，并与历史股价数据结合使用。本研究评估了在整个观测期内以及不同市场阶段（牛市、停滞期和强势牛市）下的预测性能。研究结果表明，情感特征在特定情境下能够提升预测准确性，尤其是在停滞期阶段，且TextBlob在特定场景中表现优于FinBERT。
tldr: 本研究以英伟达公司为例，将FinBERT和TextBlob两种工具从金融新闻中提取的情感分数融入Bi-LSTM和多层感知机模型进行股价预测，发现情感特征在特定市场阶段（尤其是停滞期）能显著提升预测准确性。
en_tdlr: This study integrates sentiment scores extracted from financial news headlines by FinBERT and TextBlob into Bi-LSTM and MLP models to predict Nvidia's stock prices, finding that sentiment features enhance predictive accuracy in specific market phases, particularly during stagnation periods.
